Error: a unknown dialog is open and blocking the page, so "snap" did not run.
Hint: a unknown dialog is open and blocking the page. Run "sutradhar dialog accept [text]" or "sutradhar dialog dismiss", or set a policy with --dialog accept|dismiss. For a dialog type "unknown", that same command identifies and names the specific tab actually holding the dialog and recovers by closing just that tab (never a different, healthy tab it merely shares a browser process with). If nothing else works, "sutradhar close" ends the whole session so you can start a fresh one.
